description:
The Geospatial Enterprise Open Data Store (GEODS) contract provides integration, design, development, and sustainment for data services in support of the Federal Government. Regularly, developers on GEODS are involved in designing and implementing new custom features that solve unique problems as well as updating and optimizing legacy features. Each developer can design and implement noticeable and impactful changes to the system.

 Work Schedule: 
 Day shift, Monday through Friday.

 Essential Responsibilities: 
 As an Expert Software Engineer, the expectation is that the candidate will be capable of independent software development and consistent contributions involving architecture, design, and improvement of existing and new systems. You will be expected to be self-motivated and be able to maintain consistent and clear communication of progress and be able to seek direction in performance of tasks while maintaining the big picture. 

 The Expert Software Engineer will be able to guide and mentor junior members and new members joining the program as software developers to establish and maintain a consistent culture of quality and collaboration.

 Expectations for the Expert Software Engineer include: 
 Contribute to all phases of the software development life cycle
 Write well-designed, testable, efficient, and maintainable code
 Ensure designs follow specifications approved by customer
 Contribute to planning and prioritization of work for future Program Increments
 Recommend changes to improve established application and organizational processes
 Prepare and produce releases of software components
 Support formal testing and resolution of defects
 Provide technical support and consultation for application and infrastructure defects and questions
 Guide and lead junior/mid-level developers, to include completing code reviews
 
 Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands: 
 Office environment, light physical demands, must have ability to attend to mental tasks for the duration of the workday.

 Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities): 
 At least 3 years of demonstrated experience with AWS, including but not limited to Service orchestration, deployment, and maintenance.
 At least 6 years demonstrated experience with software development using SAFe or similar Agile methodologies, to include working with Scrum Masters and/or Product Owners to decompose high level requirements into actionable user stories
 At least 6 years of demonstrated experience coding in Python or another language
 At least 6 years of demonstrated experience with DevSecOps and CI/CD, specifically utilizing GitLab or similar Git repository
 At least 6 years of demonstrated experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Terraform, CDK, or other
 At least 6 years of demonstrated experience with Container and Orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift)
 Ability to clearly communicate, verbally and in writing, complex technical concepts and challenges/obstacles in a clear and direct manner
 
 Security Clearance Required: Active TS/SCI with ability to gain and maintain a Poly

 Minimum Education: Master’s degree plus 4 years of experience, bachelor’s degree plus 6 years of experience, associate's degree plus 12 years of experience, or a minimum of 15 years of experience, in relevant field

 Minimum Years of Experience: Master’s degree plus 4 years experience, Bachelor’s degree plus 6 years experience, Associates degree plus 12 years experience, or a minimum of 15 years experience, in relevant field

 Preferred Qualifications: AI if applicable to your program
 Cloud certification(s), preferably from AWS, OCI or Google Cloud
 Experience with API design
 Experience with Multi Cloud Service Development and Coordination
 Familiarity with AI/ML, specifically Amazon SageMaker
 Familiarity with front-end development
 Experience with Atlassian suite, specifically Jira and Confluence
 Previous NGA experience
        
 Compensation Details: 
$165k - $225k        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
11/23/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
